title: Prospect maturation board
status: gate met - AC-1..AC-6 met: columns follow the recorded stage sequence (not the alphabet), a prospect with no stage keeps an explicit unclassified column, an incomplete risk reads "incomplete" and produces no chance, advancing is refused with a stated reason and writes nothing, the drop path runs the same command, and a failed read leaves the board on screen with the failure stated. Corrected while building EXP-03: the chance is now the product of the five element success probabilities (the one shared rule), not the complement of the stored overall risk.

implementation.service: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Data/Exploration/OgProspectBoard.cs (OgProspectStageRow, OgProspectCard, OgProspectColumn, OgProspectFilter, OgProspectBoardSnapshot, OgRisk, IOgProspectBoard, OgProspectBoard, BuildColumns, ChanceFromOverallRisk, IsComplete)
implementation.sharedSql: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Data/Exploration/OgExplorationSql.cs (one field-clause, escaping, value and provider-error rule for the exploration readers; EXP-01 now uses it too)
implementation.page: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop/Views/ProspectBoardPageView.cs (route 'prospects': stage columns with count/aggregate chance, list toggle, filters, selected card detail with stage history, advance command)
implementation.context: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Core/OgProspectContext.cs (the selected prospect, for the editor EXP-03 adds)
implementation.wiring: OgBootstrapper (IOgProspectBoard, OgProspectContext), OgApplication.ProspectBoard/ProspectContext, catalog 'prospects' (OgModuleKeys.Exploration), factory, en + ar labels
implementation.tests: test/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Tests/ProspectBoardTests.cs (16, no database) + ProspectBoardGatewayTests.cs (1 opt-in, real SQLite)

integration.database: SQLite PROSPECT, PLAY, PROSPECT_RISK_ASSESSMENT and PROSPECT_WORKFLOW_STAGE
integration.column_order: SCREENING (seq 1), APPRAISAL (seq 2), DRILLING (seq 3), unclassified - alphabetical would have started with APPRAISAL
integration.column_counts: 1, 2, 1, 1 across five prospects in the field; the sixth prospect belongs to another field and is absent
integration.current_stage: P-1 has SCREENING then APPRAISAL; the board shows APPRAISAL (the highest recorded sequence), entered 2026-02-01, 28 days old at the as-of date, with both stages in its history
integration.unclassified: P-3 has no stage row and appears in the unclassified column with order int.MaxValue, not dropped
integration.incomplete_risk: P-4 has RESERVOIR_RISK null: RiskComplete false, ChancePercent null, ChanceText 'incomplete', and the board counts one incomplete prospect
integration.chance: P-1's five elements (0.1, 0.2, 0.1, 0.1, 0.1) give 0.9*0.8*0.9*0.9*0.9 = 52%, the product of the element success probabilities; the derivation is unit-tested for a complete set, each missing element, an out-of-range probability, and the all-certain and all-failed extremes.
integration.filters: play 'Lower sand' returns 3 cards and still shows all 4 columns; owner, basin, minimum chance (excludes the incomplete card) and maximum stage age all narrow the cards only
integration.advance_refused: AdvanceAsync returns prospect-advance-engine-not-wired naming WFL-04/STG-14, the stage-row count is identical before and after, and re-reading still shows P-1 in APPRAISAL
integration.drop_same_check: MoveAsync returns the same reference and the same message as AdvanceAsync
integration.failed_read: with PROSPECT_WORKFLOW_STAGE dropped the load fails with a reference and no snapshot

gates.AC-1 Columns follow the reference-set or: pass - the current stage is the row with the highest recorded STAGE_SEQ_NO (then the latest start) and BuildColumns orders by that sequence, tying on the code. The SQLite test renders SCREENING, APPRAISAL, DRILLING, unclassified where alphabetical would be APPRAISAL, DRILLING, SCREENING; the unit test asserts the same order and the sequence numbers.
gates.AC-2 An unclassified stage is visible, n: pass - a prospect with no stage row gets StageOrder int.MaxValue and the label '(unclassified)', which BuildColumns places last; the unit test puts two such prospects there and the SQLite test sees P-3 in that column with all five field prospects accounted for.
gates.AC-3 Incomplete risk shows \"incomplete\: pass - RiskComplete requires all five elements (IsComplete, unit-tested for each missing element) and ChancePercent is only derived when complete; the card's ChanceText is 'incomplete', 'no chance recorded' or the percentage. The SQLite test sees P-4 as 'incomplete' with a null chance and one incomplete card counted.
gates.AC-4 Advancing is refused until the proc: pass - AdvanceAsync refuses with prospect-advance-engine-not-wired and a sentence naming WFL-04/STG-14 and saying nothing was written; the SQLite test proves the stage-row count is unchanged and P-1 is still in APPRAISAL. Input checks (actor, target, unchanged stage) run first and are unit-tested.
gates.AC-5 Drag-and-drop (if implemented) perf: pass - no drag handler is added; the drop entry point MoveAsync delegates to AdvanceAsync, and both the unit and SQLite tests assert identical reference, message and success, so a future drop cannot take another path.
gates.AC-6 A failed read does not clear the bo: pass - the page resolves each read through ProspectBoardPageView.AfterRead, which keeps the previous snapshot and the selected card on failure; a unit test asserts the same instance survives a failed read and is replaced by a successful one. The service returns no snapshot on failure, and the smoke asserts the page is never both failed and populated.

limits: The stage order is the sequence the records carry (STAGE_SEQ_NO); no stage catalog with its own order is seeded, so a stage that has never been recorded cannot appear as an empty column.

The chance is the product of the five element success probabilities, computed only when every element is a usable 0..1 value; the assessment's stored OVERALL_GEOLOGICAL_RISK is not used for the number, so a database whose overall risk disagrees with its elements shows the element-derived chance.
Basin comes from PLAY.BASIN_ID through the prospect's play; a prospect with no play row has no basin and is excluded by a basin filter.
The minimum-chance and maximum-age filters exclude cards whose chance or stage date is unknown, because neither can be shown to meet a threshold.
The list view is a read-only grid of the same cards; it cannot be sorted or exported, and there is no drag-and-drop board interaction to exercise.
Opening a prospect records it in OgProspectContext and says the editor arrives with EXP-03; there is no editor page yet.
The board reads every prospect in the field in one pass (no paging); a field with very many prospects would need a bounded read.
The page is exercised by construction (the smoke builds every catalog page and audits it) and by unit/integration tests; no automated click drives the columns or the filters.

EXP-03 introduced OgProspectChance as the single chance rule and this board now calls it; the earlier 1 - OVERALL_GEOLOGICAL_RISK derivation recorded here was replaced, and the gateway test's expected value changed from 60% to 52%.
